meta.name: obsidian-weekly-summary
meta.description: Summarize the current week from the Obsidian Zettelkasten daily notes. Reads all daily notes for the current calendar week (Monday through today) from the 06 Daily/ folder and produces a structured German-language summary of the most important things done: completed tasks, sport, learning, social events, media consumed, and highlights. Use whenever the user asks for a weekly review, weekly summary, "was habe ich diese Woche gemacht", "Wochenrückblick", "weekly recap", or wants to see what happened this week.
